### la Herramienta de NPS (The NPS Tool)

This utility is for setting the Non-Protective Settings (NPS) when setting up tag instances. This works well for opc tag writes that use the same UDT Definition. 

####
> *It will work for memory tags also, but will only set it to override. If memory tags need to be changed, set the default in the UDT definition first.*
####

1. Browse to the UDT instance that is being changed. Input the changes necessary on the top right input boxes. 
1. Click on 'Stage Changes' to save the changes to write to that instance. 
1. Click 'Write Changes' and confirm. 
1. When changes are written, an Export Changes button will appear.
   1. Click the button to open a popup with a table of all changes written in the current perspective session. The table includes the tagpath written to, the old value, the new value, and the returned result from the writeBlocking command.
   1. The button on the popup will download the table to a .csv file and clear the table.
